Resources Partner Portal Support Request demo Cybersecurity built the European way. We make cybersecurity look easy, so MSPs look brilliant. Let’s get your customers secure See it work Become the trusted partner your customers need The threats have evolved. So have we. Cyber threats aren’t what they used to be. That’s where we come in. Built in Europe, powered by AI, and designed with MSPs, our Elements Cloud platform protects your customers before threats become problems. Fast onboarding Proactive, AI powered security AI-driven detection and exposure management find threats before they find you. Most security tools wait for the breach. WithSecure Elements looks ahead using exposure management, AI-driven detection, and continuous monitoring to stop threats before they start. Compliance by design Built where privacy is law, not an afterthought. Every solution meets GDPR, NIS2, and ISO 27001 standards by default, so MSPs and your customers stay compliant automatically. The Co-security model We don’t outsource. We partner. WithSecure works alongside you as an extension of your team, combining local expertise, automation, and 24/7 support to cover every gap. Whether you have your own SOC or not, we can provide you with the right level of service needed. Simple. Scalable. Seamless. One multi-tenant platform. All your customers’, licenses, and alerts in one place. Automated, efficient, and built to grow with your business, not against it. Security that fits your business, not the other way around. WithSecure offers you benefits and solutions that make it easy for MSPs to sell cybersecurity and simple to manage. The result: satisfied customers who trust your services. Scale without the stress Manage every customer, license, and alert from a single dashboard built to scale. No complexity, just growth. Automate what slows you down Let automation take the night shift. Routine updates, detections, and reports handled. That way you can focus on protecting business, not pushing buttons. Compliance built in Compliance isn’t a checklist here, it’s in the architecture. We meet every major European standard by default, so your clients start secure from day one. Real people. Real support. Behind every alert is a human who knows what to do. Our experts watch your back around the clock. Protection plans that actually make sense. Choose from subscription or usage-based models that scale with your business. Predictable costs, no lock-ins, and no unpleasant surprises. See MSP offering Build your cybersecurity business in 6 steps 01 Fast onboarding Work with a partner who takes security as seriously as you do and be live from 24 hours. 02 Engage & assess We start with a conversation, not a sales pitch. What are your goals? How can we help you offer more and stress less? Once we know that, we can put together a roadmap built around your business, not ours. 03 Build your offering Create a security portfolio that scales and sells. Design flexible bundles that integrate with your existing tools and create service levels that fit your client needs. Use our tools to work out the best pricing, margins, and market fit. 04 Enable & launch Get up to speed with our Partner Academy for onboarding and training and set up Elements Cloud so you can automate and centrally manage everything. Then get clients started with trial licenses that help them see the real-world value with live scans/reports. 05 Go to market & grow We don’t just help you build, we help you sell with co-branded campaigns, white-label materials, and joint events to drive leads. Regular performance reviews keep your services sharp and ahead of new threats. 06 Deliver & optimize Our Co-security approach means we work beside you from incident response and threat hunting to customer success and upsell opportunities.That way you stay the hero.
